scope: Standalone mathematical operator oracle only; no Atlas/kernel import, model admission or native execution
jacobian: row output Mandel component, column unit input Mandel direction; all6directions
input_semantics: Actual finite binary64 Mandel components converted by Decimal.from_float; offdiagonal Cartesian conversion uses Decimal sqrt2 at each precision. Constructed rounded rotations are not assumed exact supplied spectra.
algorithm: Independent forward matrix power-series and differentiated term recurrence; scale until Cartesian infinity norm<=1/8; adaptive absolute tail-term termination3successive terms; square with product-rule Fréchet recurrence.
implementation_support: exact Mandel Frobenius<=64; production computed-boundary roundoff remains a separate policy
